fred.headline: Strongest week yet, sim still to log
fred.summary: Monday, Tuesday (done Wednesday), hockey and Friday are logged, knee 0 all week, average RPE 7.8 vs 7.7 last week; the stations 1 to 4 sim is not in yet. Tuesday's 4 x 1 km averaged 5:37 with a 13 s spread, 8 s per km under target, and every lift went up or held. Week 9 is your first full sim at 85%, so I trimmed Friday's EMOM to 16 min and set Tuesday's pace from your reps.
strengths: Strength is moving: trap bar 245 lb x 6, 6, 5 at RIR 1 (225 lb two weeks ago), Bayesian curls 55 lb (50), incline curls 30 lb x 8 on all 4 sets (27.5), overhead triceps 90 lb (85), and hammer curls finally done, 3 x 8 at 30 lb after two skipped Fridays.
Intervals: 5:31, 5:39, 5:44, 5:35 for an average of 5:37/km against a 5:45 target, 13 s spread, heart rate 156 to 169 on the watch reps.
Grip: farmers carry at 70 lb per hand on Monday, above the 2 x 32 kg (70.5 lb) the week 9 EMOM asks for.
weaknesses: Monday was RPE 9 with 5 s left on the sled (260 lb) and carries, the DB walking lunges before the EMOM burnt your legs, and the cable crunch was skipped.

Friday's EMOM at 200 m / 20 wall balls / 200 m still left only 5 s, so the engine under fatigue is the limiter, not strength; burpee broad jumps (3:02 for 40 m) and sandbag lunges (2:56 for 48 m) from the week 6 sim are still your biggest race losses.
Run volume: 4 of the 8 km core target so far (the sim's 4 km is still to come), and no mobility ticks this week; the ankle rocks are what let you sit into wall balls with heels down.
tips: Saturday's sim is not logged yet. If you do it Sunday, make it the stations 1 to 4 half sim and skip the zone 2 run, so you start week 9 fresh. Saturday's Garmin looks good again: 7.8 h of sleep, resting HR 45, HRV 57 vs 50 average, after two nights under 6 h.

Wall balls, 20 per minute on Friday: feet just wider than shoulders with toes slightly out, ball high under the chin with elbows under it, an arm's length from the wall, eyes on one spot of the target, and sit straight down with heels flat. Do the technique 2 x 10 slow, then keep that same stance when tired in the EMOM.

Weight: judge the week without the post party Monday. 157.1 lb on the other five days is on your line (about 156.3 lb this week, 153 lb by end of December). Protein first on the party weekends, no late food after drinking, back on plan Monday.

tweaks.text: EMOM back to sled push 280 lb over 24 m and farmers 48 m at 2 x 32 kg, as you asked; back squat 3 x 5 at 165 lb (all 155 sets felt RIR 3+), keep the bar placement the same every set.

will.headline: Knee quiet, now run and Fridays
will.summary: Monday (trap bar, sled, EMOM 12 min) and two hockey games are logged, knee 2 then 0 and 0, average RPE 6.7 vs 5.0 last week. Tuesday's intervals, Friday and the sim are missing, so run km is 0 of the 9 km core target; that is the second week without a Friday. Week 9 has the first full sim, so I brought lunges back gently on Monday, kept Tuesday at 5 reps and shortened Friday's EMOM.
strengths: Knee: 0/10 at both hockey games and 2/10 on Monday even with 10 lunges per leg and a 20 kg bag, down from 7 and 6 three weeks ago.
Sled push 255 lb in the Monday EMOM, more than your 250 lb sim weight, and trap bar 235 lb at RIR 2 ("j'aurais pu mettre plus de poids").
Recovery data is steady: resting HR 59 to 61 and 6.3 to 8.1 h of sleep on the Apple Watch, body weight 185.6 lb average (184.6 last week).
weaknesses: No interval session and no Friday this week, and only one run in two weeks: your runs averaged about 7:05/km in the week 6 sim vs 5:53 goal pace, so running is the biggest part of your 1:25 gap.
Sandbag lunges (5:00 for 48 m) and burpee broad jumps (3:53 for 40 m) in the week 6 sim are the slowest stations; the arms blocks and pull ups have not been done since Nov 3.
Monday's EMOM left only 5 s on the sled and the carries while still getting over the flu.
tips: Lock in your four weekday sessions now: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday hockey, Friday. A second hockey game is extra training, it does not replace the Tuesday run.
Tuesday: 5 x 1 km at 6:15/km, not faster on rep 1 (last time 6:04 then 6:36 on the last). Even reps beat fast first reps.
Saturday's full sim at 85% is the first one with all 8 stations at full distance: start run 1 at 6:30, take the burpee broad jumps steady, and log every lap so we get real splits.
